Settings.ArchiveFilenameRegexHint: Regular expression used as a first-stage bulk-upload filename gate. The embedded archive manifest remains authoritative.
Settings.ModuleIncludeRegexHint: Only matching module IDs are shown. Empty means all registered modules.
Settings.ModuleExcludeRegexHint: Matching module IDs are hidden from the dashboard, but remain registered in the API.
Settings.AutoProcessDropHint: When enabled, a clean bulk drop proceeds directly to validation, one bulk confirmation, import, and optional reload. Disable to customize partial selections before processing.
Settings.StopBulkOnFailure: Stop bulk import on first failure
Settings.StopBulkOnFailureHint: When enabled, later queued archives are not applied after an earlier archive fails. Completed archives remain committed and independently audited.

Bulk.DropTitle: Drop one or many framework ZIPs here
Bulk.DropHint: Each ZIP is inspected, integrity-checked and routed by its embedded manifest.

Diagnostics.NoAudit: No audit logs have been recorded.

Conflict.Title: Resolve Import Conflicts
Conflict.Intro: Resolve every differing element before any import transaction is applied.

Selection.Title: Choose Import Contents
Selection.Intro: Choose the archive elements to import. Required dependencies are added automatically; locked elements are declared non-partial by the integration.
